title: cairn cleanup clears an outline-check trouble once a later check read the ticket
intention: The tester's recheck gains the outline-check kind: red-tickets-outline-check-<tid> clears once the newest <commons>/outline_checks/<tid>-<stamp>.json reads ran True, and bin/cmd/cleanup's seals step hands it those ids.
why: Measured 2026-11-19: red-tickets-outline-check-b7987e439273 stands live, raised when the 20261118T204848 check read ran False; the 20261119T093117 re-check reads ran True, and nothing clears the trouble. red_tickets._outline_check raises it (ticket a5be53f269ac); the tester's recheck (17b087f2483f) knows only the seal kinds.
traces_to: Law 7: a record of truth stays true. A trouble standing after a later check read the ticket tells the inbox reader something false.
how: In cairn/devices/tester/recheck.py: OUTLINE = 'red-tickets-outline-check-'; recheck(..., outline_root=None) defaults to $CAIRN_OUTLINE_CHECKS_DIR or ROOTS['commons']/outline_checks; for an OUTLINE id, _outline_read(tid) reads the newest <tid>-*.json (sorted by name) and clears when ran is True, else stands. In bin/cmd/cleanup: add the prefix to recheck_seals' filter and the help text. Proof: cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_cleanup_clears_an_outline_check_a_later_check_read.py (clauses 1-3).

clauses.claim: a trouble whose newest record reads ran True (an older one False) is cleared by recheck
a trouble whose newest record reads ran False (an older one True), or that has no record, stands
in a scratch HOME with CAIRN_OUTLINE_CHECKS_DIR at scratch records, a raised and drained trouble is reported cleared on bin/cairn cleanup's seals line and is gone from cairn trouble live

decisions.text: D1: the tester clears its own outline-check trouble; the record is read as a commons file through ROOTS, never through codemother's code (RULE 1).
D2: cleanup's seals step passes the new prefix to cairn test --recheck-troubles; no new step.
D3: the proof is red-first: teeth 1-2 in-process over scratch stores (17b087f2483f's world), tooth 3 through bin/cairn cleanup in a scratch HOME (ea354f41ec67's world).

out: the seal-red and held-red kinds (17b087f2483f, unchanged)

measured.saw: red-tickets-outline-check-b7987e439273 live; its records read ran False (20261118T204848) then ran True (20261119T093117)

the drafted proof: green twice; red at HEAD (teeth 1-3), red with the cleanup prefix reverted (3), red with the env override removed (3); 17b087f2483f and ea354f41ec67 proofs green; _outline_read over the live commons returns the 093117 record, ran True
measured.how: bin/cairn test in worktree outline-check-recheck at 2b4cbe50a, each revert restored from a saved copy
